responsibility: Builds and maintains IRA allocno live ranges over numbered program points. It scans RTL on an allocno/object basis to create live-range lists, populate per-point start/finish chains, record object hard-register conflicts and call-crossing information, and accumulate register-pressure and pressure-excess metrics used by region formation and allocation heuristics. It also provides live-range compression and rebuild support after IRA emits new code, making this file the liveness and pressure analysis layer for IRA.
